title: The player Returns to TMB

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: I knew you wouldn't stay away for long. Good stuff isn't it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew you wouldn't stay away for long. Good stuff isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: I once helped a friend trade in every single implant he had for an experimental taste augmentor, just so he could take a hit of it any time he wanted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I once helped a friend trade in every single implant he had for an experimental taste augmentor, just so he could take a hit of it any time he wanted.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Naaaa it blew the bottom of his jaw off but I still don't think he regretted it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Naaaa it blew the bottom of his jaw off but I still don't think he regretted it.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: You're about as good at lying as you are seasoning noodles my friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're about as good at lying as you are seasoning noodles my friend.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Not interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not interested.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Thanks, I do what I can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, I do what I can.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: I don't need no judgement from you. He asked for help. I gave it to him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't need no judgement from you. He asked for help. I gave it to him.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Even if I could. Why would I want to? I'm street scum now, I don't want to find out that I used to be sewer scum.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Even if I could. Why would I want to? I'm street scum now, I don't want to find out that I used to be sewer scum.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: Before it all went wrong they were able to implant a single memory. That's it. Everything else was blank.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Before it all went wrong they were able to implant a single memory. That's it. Everything else was blank.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: In my memory I have a family. Parents. A sister. We're dirt poor, living in a shack, it stinks. It's my birthday. There's a cake my 'mother' has made.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In my memory I have a family. Parents. A sister. We're dirt poor, living in a shack, it stinks. It's my birthday. There's a cake my 'mother' has made.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: It feels like a big deal, like she'd saved all year for it. Ridiculous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It feels like a big deal, like she'd saved all year for it. Ridiculous.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: It's all irrelevant. It's not real.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's all irrelevant. It's not real.

nodes.speaker: Miso Baron
nodes.text: You do you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah, really good!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, really good!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The miso? Not really my thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The miso? Not really my thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The miso? Not really my thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The miso? Not really my thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did it work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did it work?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What makes you think I'm lying?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What makes you think I'm lying?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What makes you think I'm lying?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What makes you think I'm lying?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I found someone involved in this CBI stuff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found someone involved in this CBI stuff.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I found someone involved in this CBI stuff.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I found someone involved in this CBI stuff.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't want to find out about your past?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't want to find out about your past?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don't want to find out about your past?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don't want to find out about your past?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess it was nice of you to help him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess it was nice of you to help him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess it was nice of you to help him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess it was nice of you to help him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Some "friend" you are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some "friend" you are.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could have been a good person. Do you remember anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could have been a good person. Do you remember anything?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could have been a good person. Do you remember anything?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could have been a good person. Do you remember anything?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you should at least find out your real name. Do you remember anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you should at least find out your real name. Do you remember anything?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you should at least find out your real name. Do you remember anything?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you should at least find out your real name. Do you remember anything?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And what was this synthetic memory?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what was this synthetic memory?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And what was this synthetic memory?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And what was this synthetic memory?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Cakes aren't cheap. A glitch in the memory?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Cakes aren't cheap. A glitch in the memory?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Cakes aren't cheap. A glitch in the memory?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Cakes aren't cheap. A glitch in the memory?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like a happy memory.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like a happy memory.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like a sad memory.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like a sad memory.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I met someone who writes these memories I'll ask her about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I met someone who writes these memories I'll ask her about it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I met someone who writes these memories I'll ask her about it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I met someone who writes these memories I'll ask her about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You had a mother saving pennies for a birthday cake?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You had a mother saving pennies for a birthday cake?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You had a mother saving pennies for a birthday cake?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You had a mother saving pennies for a birthday cake?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You know what they say about cakes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know what they say about cakes?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You know what they say about cakes?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You know what they say about cakes?
